title: Chiang Mai to Pai & Mae Hong Son: Northern Thailand Mountain Loop
subtitle: A 4-day adventure through 762 curves in the Thai highlands

route.charger: EA Anyonde Pai (limited — charge fully in Chiang Mai)
route.kidActivities: Pai Canyon walking trails, Pam Bok Waterfall
Tham Lod Cave (bamboo rafting), Pai night market
Long Neck Karen Village, Mae Hong Son Lake, Tham Pla Cave

route.charger: Full hotel charge overnight, EA Anyonde Chiang Mai on return
route.kidActivities: Morning market visit, mountain viewpoints, Doi Inthanon National Park

bestFor: Adventurous families wanting Thailand's most scenic mountain drive
tips: Charging is sparse in Mae Hong Son province — charge fully before departing Chiang Mai
Bring a portable Type 2 charger for hotel wall outlet charging
762 curves on Route 1095 — drive slowly, especially in rain (June-October)
Pai has a couple of EA Anyonde chargers — use them whenever available
seasonal: November to February (cool, clear skies, no rain)
